supplements.title: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate Suppresses Glioma by Targeting Integrin αvβ3/FAK/ERK Signaling Axis and Matrix Metalloproteinases.
supplements.summary: Green tea compound EGCG suppresses glioma growth by blocking signaling pathways and works better combined with standard chemotherapy.

supplements.title: An Update on the Therapeutic Potential of Bixin and Norbixin Apocarotenoids.
supplements.summary: Bixin and norbixin, natural plant pigments, show promise treating metabolic disorders and various health conditions beyond their traditional cosmetic uses.

supplements.title: Total glucosides of paeony ameliorate post-stroke depression-like behaviors by modulating inflammasome activation via inhibition of endoplasmic reticulum stress.
supplements.summary: Paeony extract reduces depression-like symptoms after stroke by decreasing harmful inflammation in the brain.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of β-hydroxybutyrate in a post-traumatic stress disorder model: Behavioral, endocrine, and amygdala-hippocampal apoptotic modulation in male and female rats.
supplements.summary: β-hydroxybutyrate reduced PTSD-like symptoms and normalized stress hormones and brain cell death markers in male and female rats.

supplements.title: Integrated proteomics and metabolomics reveal NF-κB pathway modulation by Xiangpi Shengji ointment and Qingre Zaoshi compound in anal fistula wound healing.
supplements.summary: Herbal ointment accelerates anal fistula wound healing by suppressing the NF-κB inflammatory pathway and promoting beneficial immune cell changes.

supplements.title: Potato protein hydrolysate (PP902) inhibits dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy by regulating MuRF1 and MAFbx expression in C2C12 myotubes in vitro.
supplements.summary: Potato protein extract PP902 prevents steroid-induced muscle loss by blocking specific atrophy-related genes in muscle cells.

supplements.title: Characterization of In Vitro metabolic profiles of crepidatin in human liver microsomes and hepatocytes using HPLC-MS/MS and HPLC-Q-Orbitrap-HRMS.
supplements.summary: Researchers mapped how the body metabolizes crepidatin, a plant compound showing promise against lung cancer, identifying its breakdown pathways and key enzymes involved.

supplements.title: Spatial localization and pharmacodynamic assessment of intracrine androgen metabolism in CRPC xenograft tumor tissues upon active vitamin D treatment.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D reduces prostate cancer growth by disrupting the tumor's internal androgen production pathway.

supplements.title: Folate promotes colorectal cancer progression by impairing CD8+ T cell function and recruitment via SLC19A1/p-AKT/NOTCH1 axis and CCL5 downregulation.
supplements.summary: Folate supplementation promotes colorectal cancer growth by weakening immune cells that normally fight the disease.

supplements.title: Proteomics signature of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity and risk of multimorbidity of cancer and cardiometabolic diseases.
supplements.summary: Moderate-to-vigorous exercise reduces risk of cancer, heart disease, and diabetes occurring together, though the biological mechanisms need further study.

supplements.title: Homoharringtonine inhibits growth and migration in non-small cell lung cancer via PDIA4-mediated modulation of autophagy and EMT.
supplements.summary: Homoharringtonine inhibits non-small cell lung cancer growth and spread by blocking a protein called PDIA4 and triggering autophagy.

supplements.title: A randomized phase II trial of gemcitabine, nab-paclitaxel, cisplatin with or without a medically supervised ketogenic diet for patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers tested whether a medically supervised ketogenic diet combined with chemotherapy improved outcomes in patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.

supplements.title: Imperatorin Mitigates Rosacea-Like Inflammation by Modulating the Crosstalk Between JNK1 and STAT1.
supplements.summary: Imperatorin, a natural compound, reduces rosacea-like skin inflammation by blocking harmful protein interactions that trigger inflammation.

supplements.title: Role of reactive oxygen species in polycystic ovary syndrome: signalling pathways, mechanisms, and traditional Chinese medicine treatment strategies.
supplements.summary: Excessive cellular oxidative stress drives polycystic ovary syndrome symptoms, treatable through traditional Chinese medicine approaches.

supplements.title: Research progress of curcumin and its derivatives as anti-inflammatory agents: From molecular mechanism to clinical application.
supplements.summary: Curcumin shows anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor promise, but improved delivery methods are needed to enhance its effectiveness in clinical use.

off_label.title: Metformin Blunts Vascular Insulin Sensitivity After Exercise Training in Adults at Risk for Metabolic Syndrome.
off_label.summary: Metformin may reduce the vascular health benefits normally gained from exercise training in people at metabolic risk.

off_label.title: The mitochondrial gambit: Re-evaluating Antimycin A as a multi-pronged anti-cancer agent.
off_label.summary: Antimycin A, a mitochondrial inhibitor, kills cancer cells through multiple mechanisms including energy depletion, protein destruction, and stem cell targeting.

off_label.title: Delivering precision oncology in metastatic breast cancer: Clinical impact of comprehensive genomic profiling-The CATCH experience.
off_label.summary: Genomic testing identified actionable mutations in metastatic breast cancer, enabling personalized treatments that extended progression-free survival in one-third of patients.

off_label.title: An oncogenic, truncated FGFR1 variant cooperates with SPFQ/NONO to regulate gene transcription in FGFR1-driven leukaemia.
off_label.summary: A truncated FGFR1 protein drives leukemia by partnering with SFPQ and NONO proteins to control genes, offering a new treatment target.

off_label.title: DPP9 inhibition boosts antitumor immunity by disrupting BRISC-mediated PD-L1 expression in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking DPP9 reduces PD-L1 expression in kidney cancer, enhancing immune checkpoint therapy effectiveness and T cell tumor-killing ability.

off_label.title: Deciphering the groove-binding mode of dolutegravir with salmon sperm DNA through spectroscopic and molecular modelling approaches.
off_label.summary: Dolutegravir, an HIV drug, binds to DNA grooves and may be repositioned as a potential cancer treatment through targeted drug development strategies.

off_label.title: Enhanced antidepressant effects of fluoxetine combined with quercetin: studies in vitro and in vivo.
off_label.summary: Combining fluoxetine with quercetin, a natural compound, boosts antidepressant effects in laboratory and animal studies.

off_label.title: Risks of thrombosis and hemorrhage in concurrent use of anticoagulants and potential interacting prostate cancer agents.
off_label.summary: Prostate cancer drugs may dangerously interact with blood thinners, increasing risks of clots or bleeding.

off_label.title: Nitroxoline Enhances Radiosensitivity in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Suppressing STAT3-AKT-MTOR Survival Signaling.
off_label.summary: Nitroxoline, an existing antimicrobial drug, enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in lung cancer by blocking survival pathways.

off_label.title: Molecular Lung Imaging Following Exposure to Radiation Predicts Long-Term Survival in Rats.
off_label.summary: Lung imaging after radiation exposure can predict which rats survive long-term and whether treatment with lisinopril works.

off_label.title: A system biology-based identification of potential biomarker interlinking the effect of anti-diabetic drug, Metformin, on reduced occurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Metformin reduces hepatocellular carcinoma risk by targeting protein kinase B, a key protein in cancer development pathways.

off_label.title: Effect of anticancer activity of aripiprazole main metabolite OPC-14857 on malignant glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole's metabolite OPC-14857 shows potent anticancer effects against glioblastoma, potentially outperforming current standard treatment.

off_label.title: Dose-Dependent Impact of Metformin on Osteoblast-Specific Biomarkers in Cultured Rat Primary Osteoblasts.
off_label.summary: Low-dose metformin (up to 1 mM) promotes bone cell growth and function while high doses become toxic to these cells.

off_label.title: Valsartan Mitigates LPS-Induced Neuroinflammation and Cognitive Deficits via Modulation of RAS-ECS Crosstalk in Mice.
off_label.summary: Valsartan, a blood pressure medication, reduces brain inflammation and improves memory in mice with Alzheimer's-like disease.

off_label.title: Treating Heart Dysfunction Related to Cancer Therapy With Sacubitril/Valsartan (Treat HF)
off_label.summary: A study testing whether a heart medication can safely treat early heart damage in young cancer survivors from chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: LDH isozymes as targets for cancer therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose targeting lactate dehydrogenase isozymes, especially LDH-C, as a selective metabolic strategy to combat cancer.

biomarkers.title: Anal Human Papillomavirus Infection Progression to Disease Among Men Who Have Sex With Men.
biomarkers.summary: Study tracks how anal HPV infection develops into anal cancer and precancerous lesions in HIV-negative men who have sex with men.

biomarkers.title: Metformin Blunts Vascular Insulin Sensitivity After Exercise Training in Adults at Risk for Metabolic Syndrome.
biomarkers.summary: Metformin may reduce the vascular health benefits normally gained from exercise training in people at metabolic risk.

biomarkers.title: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate Suppresses Glioma by Targeting Integrin αvβ3/FAK/ERK Signaling Axis and Matrix Metalloproteinases.
biomarkers.summary: Green tea compound EGCG suppresses glioma growth by blocking signaling pathways and works better combined with standard chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: High-grade follicular B-cell lymphoma-associated C3 rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis: a rare association.
biomarkers.summary: Follicular B-cell lymphoma rarely causes kidney inflammation, but targeted cancer treatment successfully restored kidney function and achieved remission.

biomarkers.title: The correlation between cardiac T2*MRI and B-Type natriuretic peptides in patients with transfusion-dependent anemias and systemic iron overload: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Cardiac MRI and blood markers both effectively detect heart damage from iron buildup in patients requiring frequent blood transfusions.

biomarkers.title: The prevalence and predictors of previous prostate cancer screening among men attending primary healthcare centers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified factors predicting whether Saudi men had received prostate cancer screening at primary healthcare centers.

biomarkers.title: Targeted therapy for DNA damage response and homologous recombination repair defects: The Olaparib Combinations trial.
biomarkers.summary: A trial tests whether PARP inhibitor drugs, alone or combined with other therapies, effectively treat cancers with specific DNA repair gene mutations.

biomarkers.title: The impact of the patient macroenvironment on molecular subgroups in endometrial cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Obesity and age significantly influence endometrial cancer molecular subtypes and survival outcomes beyond genetic factors alone.

biomarkers.title: Multi-Omics Data Reveal Estrogen-Driven Dysregulation and Stromal-Epithelial Signaling Alterations in Endometrial Polyps.
biomarkers.summary: Endometrial polyps show excessive estrogen signaling and abnormal communication between stromal and epithelial cells, offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Rapid microfluidic sample preparation for mass spectrometric analysis of wild-type and mutant BRAF protein.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a faster microfluidic method to detect BRAF cancer mutations in colorectal cancer samples using mass spectrometry.

biomarkers.title: A peptide-functionalized quantum Dots/MOF nanosheets fluorescence biosensor for glutathione sensing and cellular imaging.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a sensor to detect glutathione, a molecule elevated in tumors that promotes cancer growth and drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Modeling-prediction-based-HPLC-MS/MS with stable isotope labeling: A strategy for static-dynamic profiling of sphingolipid alterations in hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how glucose and palmitic acid differently alter sphingolipids in hepatocellular carcinoma using advanced tracking methods.

biomarkers.title: Targeting hepatocellular carcinoma with MAGE-A3-specific TCR-engineered T cells: A therapeutic approach.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed engineered T cells targeting MAGE-A3 protein to treat hepatocellular carcinoma more effectively.

biomarkers.title: PARP inhibitor combined with platinum activates the cGAS-STING pathway to enhance anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy in lung adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Combining PARP inhibitor with platinum chemotherapy boosts lung cancer response to immunotherapy by activating immune-stimulating pathways.

trials.title: Then and Now: What We Have Learned From the WHI.
trials.summary: Women's Health Initiative studies show menopausal hormone therapy carries both risks and benefits for postmenopausal women.

trials.title: Anal Human Papillomavirus Infection Progression to Disease Among Men Who Have Sex With Men.
trials.summary: Study tracks how anal HPV infection develops into anal cancer and precancerous lesions in HIV-negative men who have sex with men.

trials.title: EUS-Guided Radiofrequency Ablation as a Minimally Invasive Treatment for Insulinomas-A Single-Center Experience.
trials.summary: Doctors successfully used a minimally invasive ultrasound-guided heat treatment to destroy insulinomas, rare pancreatic tumors causing dangerous low blood sugar.

trials.title: High-grade follicular B-cell lymphoma-associated C3 rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis: a rare association.
trials.summary: Follicular B-cell lymphoma rarely causes kidney inflammation, but targeted cancer treatment successfully restored kidney function and achieved remission.

trials.title: The prevalence and predictors of previous prostate cancer screening among men attending primary healthcare centers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
trials.summary: Researchers identified factors predicting whether Saudi men had received prostate cancer screening at primary healthcare centers.

trials.title: Patient-reported outcomes in NRG Oncology RTOG 1010: Phase 3 trial evaluating the addition of trastuzumab to trimodality treatment of HER2 overexpressing esophageal adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Adding trastuzumab to standard treatment improved quality of life in HER2-positive esophageal cancer patients.

trials.title: Targeted therapy for DNA damage response and homologous recombination repair defects: The Olaparib Combinations trial.
trials.summary: A trial tests whether PARP inhibitor drugs, alone or combined with other therapies, effectively treat cancers with specific DNA repair gene mutations.

trials.title: Review of patient-reported outcomes in EMPOWER-Lung 1 in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer treated with cemiplimab versus chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Lung cancer patients treated with cemiplimab reported better quality of life outcomes compared to those receiving chemotherapy.

trials.title: The impact of the patient macroenvironment on molecular subgroups in endometrial cancer.
trials.summary: Obesity and age significantly influence endometrial cancer molecular subtypes and survival outcomes beyond genetic factors alone.

trials.title: Digital siblings unveil distinct molecular and clinical subtypes in Alzheimer's disease via omics-driven profiling.
trials.summary: Researchers identified distinct Alzheimer's disease patient subgroups using molecular data analysis, revealing different disease mechanisms and enabling personalized treatment approaches.

trials.title: Targeting hepatocellular carcinoma with MAGE-A3-specific TCR-engineered T cells: A therapeutic approach.
trials.summary: Researchers developed engineered T cells targeting MAGE-A3 protein to treat hepatocellular carcinoma more effectively.

trials.title: PARP inhibitor combined with platinum activates the cGAS-STING pathway to enhance anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy in lung adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Combining PARP inhibitor with platinum chemotherapy boosts lung cancer response to immunotherapy by activating immune-stimulating pathways.

trials.title: Trimethyl Lock-2Cl (TML-2Cl): A self-cyclizing adapter for molecular release in antibody-drug conjugates.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new adapter (TML-2Cl) for antibody-drug conjugates that improves drug release and effectively inhibits Her2-positive gastric cancer tumor growth in mice.

trials.title: Halogen-methyl hybridization unlocks orally bioavailable STING agonist for tumor immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an oral STING agonist drug (X41) that effectively shrinks tumors in mice, offering a new immunotherapy approach for solid cancers.

trials.title: Targeting DDX5 using FL118 suppresses mTOR signaling and tumorigenicity in JAK2V617F-driven myeloproliferative neoplasms.
trials.summary: FL118 drug suppresses myeloproliferative neoplasm tumors by targeting DDX5 protein and blocking cancer cell growth pathways.
